title: Open and closed source recollement on a vanishing topos
statement: Let $S$ be Noetherian, $f:X\to S$ of finite presentation and $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion with closed complement $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$. Put $f_U=fj$ and $f_Z=fi$. For the induced maps $\bar j:V_{f_U}\to V_f$ and $\bar i:V_{f_Z}\to V_f$ of [def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles], the first is an open subtopos and the second its complementary closed subtopos. The functors $\bar j^*,\bar j_!,\bar i^*,\bar i_*$ on constant-$\Lambda$ module sheaves are exact and preserve finite-stratification constructibility [def-trf-oriented-constructible-sheaf]. For every sheaf $F$ on $V_f$ the natural sequence $0\to\bar j_!\bar j^*F\to F\to\bar i_*\bar i^*F\to0$ is exact. These functors give the corresponding distinguished localization triangle on derived categories.
